gaps.lead: The famine was caused by a long drought.
gaps.explanation: A causes B = A results in B.

gaps.lead: The tickets were so expensive that we didn't buy any.
gaps.sentence: They were ___ that we didn't buy any.
gaps.explanation: so expensive (tickets) → such expensive tickets (no article with plural).

gaps.lead: 'Could you pass the salt?' said my aunt to me.
gaps.explanation: Reported request: asked me to pass.

gaps.lead: 'Don't touch the paintings,' the guard warned us.
gaps.explanation: Negative commands are reported with not + to-infinitive: warned us not to touch.

gaps.lead: People think she was the best singer of her generation.
gaps.sentence: She ___ the best singer of her generation.
gaps.explanation: A present belief about a past event uses is thought to have + participle.

gaps.sentence: Travel is ___ if you go off-peak.
